annotations.text:
Direction B's index layout, set in A's typography — Instrument Serif for the name and email, Space Grotesk for everything else.

The table alignment that monospace gave for free now comes from CSS grid plus tabular-lining numerals, so the columns still lock up without the mono texture.
The two directions you didn't pick, kept for reference. B is no longer here — it became the landing page on page 1.
